description: Symbol/reference retrieval fixtures for openamer_cli.repomap. Gold files are the files that define or call the queried symbol; prose-only documents are intentionally out of scope for a symbol map. Queries 1-2 are the discriminating cases (the caller does not import or name the symbol lexically, it calls it through an attribute or a wrapper); queries 3-6 are controls where keyword matching already succeeds.

queries.rationale: Definition plus both call sites. transport.py and test_retry.py import RetryPolicy and call policy.compute_backoff, so the symbol never appears in their import lines.
Definition plus the sibling module it wraps (client.ts calls fetchWithRetry from api.ts).
Control: the caller imports CacheStore by name, so keyword matching finds both.
Control: the caller imports record_span by name.
Control: single-file query, no cross-file references.
